passiveSkills.name: Sacred Arts Expert
passiveSkills.desc:
Increases damage for Advanced Skills
with elements and nulls resistance
to that element.

advancedSkills.name: Magic Cylinder
advancedSkills.desc:
Generates a wave of magic energy at the
targeted location. Deals damage to
enemies inside the field.

advancedSkills.name: Jerid Blade
advancedSkills.desc:
A charged Electric Type slash.
Hold the button to charge and increase
damage and attack range.

advancedSkills.name: Wind Bloom
advancedSkills.desc:
Unleashes a string of slash attacks
draped in the magic of flowers.
Deals Wind damage and may stun enemies.

advancedSkills.name: Overwhelm
advancedSkills.desc:
Relentless heavyweight attacks.
When triggered, the Elemental Fusion
gauge fills up and some HP will
be recovered.

advancedSkills.name: Heavy Attack
advancedSkills.desc:
Stronger than a Normal Attack.
Use after a Normal Attack combo to
branch into a Combo Finish.
Hold the button for Bluewind Slash,
an upward strike attack.
